lines.S1: I'm Ludwig. This is your Line: down is the past, up is what's coming. Tap Got it, and say it loudly.
lines.S2: Nobody ever planned a great night by waiting. Pull down from the top to open the Planning Curtain.
lines.S3: Type a band you'd cross a city for, then pick them from the list. I check MusicBrainz, the open music encyclopedia, so we get the right band.
lines.S4: Respectable taste. Not mine, but respectable. Tap Add to put the gig on your Line.
lines.S5: Tap the gig to open its Room. That's where the night lives.
lines.S6: I tore out every back button myself. Swipe right to go back.
lines.S7: We swap contacts in person, standing together, as music intended. Tap my name on the Exchange screen.
lines.S8: Pinch out to see my Line beside yours. Mine is longer. Naturally.
lines.S9: I bought you a ticket and sent it over; it's already on the gig. Thank me loudly.
lines.S10: The gig is getting close. Add it to your calendar, so you can't pretend you forgot.
lines.S11: Open directions to the venue in Maps. I am not carrying you there.
lines.S12: Doors are open! Tap your ticket and show it at the door.
lines.S13: We're in. Tap Check in so the night knows you were here.
lines.S14: They've started, and they're LOUD. Open the Log and write the first song they played.
lines.S15: Second song, no idea? Me neither, I couldn't hear a thing. Add a Gap: a blank entry is honest.
lines.S16: My phone heard it after all, and its gossip filled your Gap. Now write some gossip back to me.
lines.S17: setlist.fm, where fans keep the setlists, filled in the rest. I'd have remembered it better.
lines.S18: A night without proof is just a rumour. Take a selfie in your camera, come back, and choose private or shared.
lines.S19: It's over and I'm already mourning. Tap Spotify to keep the setlist as a playlist.
lines.S20: That's the Tour: the demo night is gone, the playlist is yours. Now go to a real gig and stand near the speakers.

playlist.title: Went to a gig with Ludwig
playlist.description: Achievement unlocked: survived a whole gig with Ludwig. He shouted every chorus, heard half of them and regrets nothing.
